exposure: Mode of delivery (emergency vs. elective cesarean section)
outcome: Hemoglobin drop from pre-cesarean section levels
cohort: Pregnant women with breech presentation who underwent either emergency or elective cesarean section
finding: Emergency cesarean sections in women with breech presentation were associated with lower 1-minute and 5-minute Apgar scores, lower postoperative hemoglobin levels, a greater decrease in hemoglobin levels from pre-cesarean section levels, and longer operation times.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean sections were more common in women with a cervical dilation of 2 cm or more, and this group also experienced a greater decrease in hemoglobin levels and a higher need for neonatal intensive care.
gest_age: Median gestational age at emergency cesarean section was 37 weeks
